subject.title: [Feature]: cron add: support custom job IDs via --id

question: Should `openclaw cron add` expose user-supplied stable job IDs, and what exact public contract should a replacement implementation use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a create-time ID is a public CLI/Gateway/API contract change with validation and compatibility choices that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow implementation
options.body: Accept the feature direction and require a current-main PR with safe ID validation, duplicate rejection, generated-client updates, docs, and proof.

options.title: Keep UUID-only creation
options.body: Decline the new public ID surface and keep users on generated IDs plus list/show lookup workflows.

options.title: Limit to CLI only
options.body: Allow a CLI flag only if it maps cleanly to a narrower internal contract, at the cost of not supporting all Gateway/API callers uniformly.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow implementation
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction and require a current-main PR with safe ID validation, duplicate rejection, generated-client updates, docs, and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame on the central cron create surfaces points to Peter Steinberger, and this is a public contract decision around those same files.
